agent.problem: "In this picture" depends on the preceding story card and does not identify the picture as Habakkuk's description of God measuring the earth and startling the nations. The question does not supply enough context on its own.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

human.problem: Of the 8 true-or-false cards, 7 have False as the right answer (stop 1, cards 3 and 12; stop 2, cards 4, 7 and 12; stop 3, cards 6 and 10). Only stop 1, card 8 is True. Several use the same 'X stays calm/standing' setup, so a baker can learn to pick False without reasoning.
